svg.text: LangGraph SUPERVISOR + RAG + patterns + opt-in layers (hexagonal ports)
3 — 26 specialist agents (each node returns control to the supervisor)
6 — RAG (8 engines) + VectorStorePort (hexagonal port; default Chroma)
7 — Opt-in layers (settings; flag off = byte-for-byte identical graph)
Layer 7 detail — A2A (Agent2Agent): bidirectional interop, opt-in [a2a], complements MCP (tools <-> agents)
Trust boundary: all remote content -> L1 InputSanitizer + audited (hash, no content)
